hooks.command: S="$(command -v sac || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/sac")"; [ -x "$S" ] && SET_AGENT_NAME=set-claude-handoff "$S" hook watch-guard || true
S="$(command -v sac || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/sac")"; [ -x "$S" ] && SET_AGENT_NAME=set-claude-handoff "$S" hook stop || true

S="$(command -v sac || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/sac")"; if [ -x "$S" ]; then SET_AGENT_NAME=set-claude-handoff "$S" hook session-start; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"[set-agent-comm] ⚠ `sac` is not installed on this machine (not on PATH, not in ~/.local/bin), so this project is OFF the bus here: no wake-ups, no unread-mail check, no heartbeat. Fix: run `bin/sac.mjs setup` from a set-agent-comm checkout on this machine, then restart the session."}}'; fi
S="$(command -v sac || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/sac")"; [ -x "$S" ] && SET_AGENT_NAME=set-claude-handoff "$S" hook heartbeat || true
